description: Estimate what an FDM print costs (material, electricity, machine wear, labor, failure allowance) and a suggested selling price. Needs the print weight in grams and time in hours from the slicer; all other inputs have sensible defaults (1 kg spool at $20, 120 W printer, $0.12/kWh, 5% failures).

markup_percent.description: Profit markup to compute a selling price.

printer_cost_usd.description: Printer purchase price, for depreciation. 0 to skip.

name: calculate_print_cost
title: Calculate 3D print cost
